LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed. Top-left: Causal chain diagram. Top-right: Recorded series (live) line plot. Bottom-left: Float32 bit-pattern strip. Bottom-right: State card HUD.

SERIES: The line plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss). However, the plot area is effectively empty of data lines or points; only the x and y axes (0.00 to 1.00) are visible. A purple circular marker is visible at the top-left corner of the plot area (near 0.00, 1.00), but it lacks a trailing path.

TEXT: Step 41 / 59; w = 1.3561949729919434; loss = 0.094453217079863e-05; 8 FPS drawn | step rate 25/s; bits changed 9 of 32; hex word = 0x3FAD97CC.

BITS: 32 bit squares are drawn. The orange squares (representing changed bits) are located at positions: 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 17, 19, 20, 23, 24, 25, 30 (counting from 0 on the left).

DEFECTS: The primary defect is that the "recorded series (live)" panel in the top-right is empty; despite being at step 41, no data series (lines or points) have been rendered within the plot axes. Additionally, the "state card" text in the bottom-right panel is slightly misaligned/overlapping with the x-axis labels of the bit-pattern panel above it.

VERDICT: FAIL - The dashboard frame fails to render the core time-series data in the top-right panel, leaving the "recorded series" plot blank at step 41.
